title: After dark
steps: Night has fallen over the castle, and you just cannot seem to fall asleep. Suddenly, you hear a very soft knock at your door.
Yes, I am awake. What is it, Nuri?
The older pupils say the stone passages change after dark, and that Dask, a strict teacher, patrols them so no one is out of bed. I want to go and see!
I do not know... What happens if Dask sees us?
I have a plan! We will look before every step. I will show you how to ask questions whose answer is only ever true or false.
Together, you tiptoe out into the cold passage, heading towards the watchtower's gallery. Just ahead, standing quietly by the wall, you spot a tall shadow: Dask.
